blocks.content: You've selected a data source, chosen a metric, added label filters, and applied operations. Before moving to the condition step, set the query type and run the query to verify the results.
To run and verify the query, complete the following steps:

Click **> Options** below your query to expand it, and verify **Type** is set to **Instant**.

| Type | What it returns | When to use |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Instant** | One value per series at a single point in time | Alerting (the condition needs one number to compare) |
| **Range** | Multiple data points over a time window | Dashboards and graphs |
Click **Run queries**. The table below the query shows actual results from your data source.

Check the results:

| Check | What to look for |
|-------|------------------|
| **Values** | Do the numbers make sense for what you're monitoring? |
| **Series count** | Are you getting the right number of time series? Too many may mean you need more filters. |
| **Labels** | Do the labels on each series match what you expect? |

If something looks off, go back and adjust your metric, filters, or operations before moving on.
Your query is returning the data you expect. Next, you'll set the alert condition.
